d: Will Mohammed Siraj make a comeback to Team India's Playing 11 for the IND vs NZ 2nd ODI? With India looking to bounce back, all eyes are on Gautam Gambhir's team selection and possible changes to the playing eleven. In this episode of Zero Cricket Knowledge, we (Chayan Rastogi, Abhishek Manchanda) discuss Mohammed Siraj's chances of returning, Gautam Gambhir's selection strategy and the roles of Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma in India's plans for the second ODI. Will Team India make the right changes, or are more selection surprises waiting for fans? We bring you our signature cricket…
